Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the correct data from the WebSurfer (which identified "Repeated Absences" as a 1972 film) and incorrectly stated it was released in 1949. This data fabrication created an irreversible error that led to the final conclusion that "Repeated Absences" came out first, when the correct answer is "She Wore A Yellow Ribbon".
